faqs.a: Yes. You can start a free analysis without registering. No third-party API key is required.

faqs.q: What does a full crawl do?
faqs.a: It analyzes every URL instead of sampling repeated URL patterns. Crawling larger sites may take longer.

faqs.q: What information does the report include?
faqs.a: Technical and on-page SEO findings, affected URLs, observed evidence and actionable fix recommendations.

faqs.q: Do crawl results show Google rankings?
faqs.a: No. This tool analyzes observable SEO issues on your website; it does not measure Google rankings or actual indexing status.

scope: Lighthouse, speed, Core Web Vitals, accessibility scores, Google rankings and actual indexing status are not measured.
